after.text: A negative result, kept as one: waving the pass-count boundary made long-wave moire worse, not better, than the plain bundleCount baseline (3.43 vs 2.90 RMS on sphere·hatch), and R2 also dropped.

It is a hatch-only law: on sphere·crosshatch it floods completely — R2, L* span, moire and highlight falloff all come back 0 because both families flood and the cell renders as a solid black disc with no tone left in it at all.
